signal_evidence.services_demand: Our Q1 results underscore the message we control what we can control... we delivered within or better than every range we set.
signal_evidence.capex_direction: We expect 2026 adjusted expenses to be between $4.3 billion and $4.6 billion. This is roughly $500 million lower than our Q4 2025 annualized exit rate at the midpoint.
signal_evidence.pricing_power: Our clients are not choosing us because we're the cheapest... over the long term, we've always said that we believe that fees could come down as things become commoditized.
signal_evidence.management_tone_shift: Total crypto market cap and total crypto trading volume were both down more than 20% quarter-over-quarter. And volatility in the long tail assets was at historic lows.
